ai.title: AI integration
ai.lead: The third-party frontier architectures BETTER benchmarks and deploys.

entries.text: Generative and inverse methods produce mask pattern corrections that raise transfer fidelity.
entries.metric: Benchmark metric: generative methods accelerate ILT iteration

entries.text: An encoder-decoder image model handles large pattern fields and locates risk areas quickly.
entries.metric: Benchmark metric: 10–30× faster than NGSPICE (metric from the original domain)

entries.text: A graph attention network predicts hotspots at layout and feeds them back into mask correction.
entries.metric: Benchmark metric: 5–12× less memory than image-based methods

entries.text: Simulates write dose, proximity effects and write time to optimize the writing strategy.
entries.metric: Benchmark metric: virtual validation lowers trial-write cost
